label: Well-Adjusted Graduate Male
summary: This profile represents respondents who report notably low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. label: Distressed High-Screen-Time Graduate Woman
summary: This profile captures respondents reporting elevated loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms relative to other clusters. Members score notably high on all three psychological distress measures (UCLA-8 loneliness mean ≈ 1.72, PHQ-9 depression mean ≈ 1.73, GAD-7 anxiety mean ≈ 2.15), suggesting a co-occurring pattern of emotional difficulties. The cluster is sizable (n = 180), indicating this is not a fringe subgroup but a substantial segment of the sample.
demographic_anchor: Female, holding a graduate degree or above, reporting more than 5 hours of daily screen time
behavior_markers: Reports higher-than-average loneliness on the UCLA-8 scale
Endorses elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows the highest anxiety symptom levels among profiles on the GAD-7
Engages in heavy daily screen use exceeding 5 hours
Co-occurrence of loneliness, depression, and anxiety suggests compounding distress
tone: Concerned and empathetic, reflecting the convergence of multiple psychological stressors in a highly educated, heavy-screen-use population
